title: Measure it, pay it
topic: Length, mass, volume, money and time
goal: I can change units, solve money problems and find how long things last.

learn.intro: Use one unit before you add or take away. 1 m = 100 cm, 1 kg = 1000 g, 1 ℓ = 1000 ml and $1 = 100¢.

example.problem: A ribbon is 3 m 40 cm long. Mei cuts off 85 cm. How long is the ribbon now?
steps: Change to cm: 3 m 40 cm = 340 cm.
example.answer: The ribbon is 2 m 55 cm long.

howto.title: Tips
steps: Write both amounts in the small unit first.
On a time line, jump to the next o’clock.

try.text: A jug holds 2 ℓ 350 ml. Ali pours out 800 ml. The jug now holds {b} ℓ {b} ml.

example2.problem: A film starts at 1:40 pm and ends at 3:15 pm. How long is the film?
steps: Jump to the next o’clock, then to 3:00, then to 3:15.
Add the jumps: 20 min + 1 h + 15 min = 1 h 35 min.
example2.answer: The film is 1 h 35 min long.

items.text: Change the units.
The ruler is shown at real size. Read the length of each object.

parts.label: c
parts.text: The pencil is {b} cm longer than the crayon.

items.explanation: The pencil starts at 3 and ends at 11: 11 - 3 = 8 cm. The crayon starts at 6 and ends at 13: 13 - 6 = 7 cm. The pencil is 8 - 7 = 1 cm longer.

items.text:
The parcels weigh: A 1 kg 80 g, B 1900 g, C 1 kg 8 g, D 1 kg 90 g. Write the letters in order. Begin with the lightest.
{b}  {b}  {b}  {b}
items.explanation: Write each in grams: A is 1080 g, B is 1900 g, C is 1008 g and D is 1090 g. In order: 1008, 1080, 1090, 1900. That is C, A, D, B.

items.text: A can has 3 ℓ 200 ml of paint. Siti pours the paint into pots. Each pot holds 500 ml.
items.explanation: 3 ℓ 200 ml = 3200 ml. 3200 ÷ 500 = 6 remainder 200. She fills 6 pots, with 200 ml left.

items.text: Read the water level in each jug.

parts.label: d
parts.text: C has {b} ml more than A

items.explanation: Each small mark is 50 ml. A is 1 mark above 300: 350 ml. B is at 600 ml. C is 1 mark above 800: 850 ml. 850 - 350 = 500 ml.

items.text: A notebook costs $2.65 and a ruler costs $1.40. Mei pays with a $5 note.
Siti has $20 and buys the first 3 things on the list.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Can she buy all 4 things on the list?   {circ:Yes|No}

items.text: 3 melons with the same mass weigh 2 kg 400 g. An apple weighs 150 g. 1 melon and 2 apples weigh {b} g.
Write the time in the other kind of time.
items.explanation: After 12 noon, add 12 to the hour for 24-hour time. (b) 1 + 12 = 13. (c) 9 + 12 = 21. For (d) and (e), take away 12: 16 - 12 = 4 and 20 - 12 = 8.

items.text: How long does each take? Use a time line to help.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Aisha’s class: 5:25 pm to 6:40 pm. It lasts {b} h {b} min.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Ben’s class starts at 3:40 pm and lasts 55 minutes. It ends at {bw}.

parts.label: c
parts.text: A show ends at 8:15 pm. It is 1 h 45 min long. It starts at {bw}.

items.explanation: (a) 5:25 to 6:00 is 35 min, then 6:00 to 6:40 is 40 min. 35 + 40 = 75 min = 1 h 15 min. (b) 3:40 + 20 min = 4:00, then 35 more min = 4:35 pm. (c) 8:15 pm - 1 h = 7:15 pm, then 45 min back = 6:30 pm.

items.text: Write the time shown on each clock.
items.explanation: The short hand shows the hour, the long hand the minutes. A: long hand at 2 is 10 minutes, short hand just past 4. B: long hand at 9 is 45 minutes. C: at 5 is 25 minutes.

items.text: A stamp costs 65¢. Kumar buys 8 stamps.

parts.label: b
parts.text: He pays with a $10 note. His change is ${bw}.

items.text: A pool has 4 swimming lessons in a row. Each lesson is 45 minutes. There is a 10 minute break between lessons. The first lesson starts at 07:30. When does the 4th lesson end? {bw}
items.explanation: Lesson 1: 07:30 to 08:15. Break. Lesson 2: 08:25 to 09:10. Break. Lesson 3: 09:20 to 10:05. Break. Lesson 4: 10:15 to 11:00. The 4th lesson ends at 11:00.
items.hint: Write the start and the end of each lesson.

items.text: Ali starts his homework at 18:35 and stops at 20:10. He has a 15 minute break. How long does he work? {b} h {b} min
items.explanation: From 18:35 to 19:00 is 25 min. 19:00 to 20:00 is 1 h. 20:00 to 20:10 is 10 min. In all 1 h 35 min. Take away the 15 min break: 1 h 20 min.
items.hint: Find the whole time first. Then take away the break.

items.text: 2 notebooks and 3 pens cost $9. A notebook costs $1.50 more than a pen.
items.explanation: The 2 notebooks cost $3 more than 2 pens (2 × $1.50). Take that away: $9 - $3 = $6 for 5 pens. A pen costs $6 ÷ 5 = $1.20. A notebook costs $1.20 + $1.50 = $2.70.
items.hint: How much more do 2 notebooks cost than 2 pens?

items.text: You have a 3 ℓ jug, a 5 ℓ jug and a tap. The jugs have no marks. You want exactly 4 ℓ.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Fill the 5 ℓ jug. Pour from it into the 3 ℓ jug until full. The 5 ℓ jug has {b} ℓ left.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Empty the 3 ℓ jug. Pour the 2 ℓ into it. Fill the 5 ℓ jug. Pour from it into the 3 ℓ jug until full. The 5 ℓ jug has {b} ℓ left.

items.explanation: (a) The 3 ℓ jug takes 3 ℓ, so 5 - 3 = 2 ℓ are left in the 5 ℓ jug. (b) The 3 ℓ jug holds 2 ℓ and has room for 1 ℓ more. The full 5 ℓ jug gives 1 ℓ, so 5 - 1 = 4 ℓ are left. That is exactly 4 ℓ.
items.hint: Follow each step. The jug is full when it holds 3 ℓ.

items.text: Mei’s watch is 8 minutes slow.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Her watch shows 4:20 pm. The real time is {bw}.

parts.label: b
parts.text: A film starts at 4:45 pm. When it starts, her watch shows {bw}.

items.explanation: (a) A slow watch is behind: the real time is 8 minutes later: 4:20 pm + 8 min = 4:28 pm. (b) At the real time 4:45 pm her watch shows 8 minutes earlier: 4:37 pm.
items.hint: A slow watch shows an earlier time than the real time.

items.text: Write a shopping story that uses $6.40 and $2.15. The answer to your story must be $4.25.

answer.text: Answers vary. Example: A book costs $6.40 and a pen costs $2.15. How much more does the book cost than the pen? The answer is $4.25.

items.explanation: The only way is the difference: 6.40 - 2.15 = 4.25. A sum of the two would be $8.55.
items.hint: Which sum or take-away of $6.40 and $2.15 gives $4.25?

items.text: A night shift starts at 22:30 and lasts 8 h 45 min. At what time does it end? Write it in 24-hour time. {bw}
items.explanation: From 22:30 to 24:00 (midnight) is 1 h 30 min. The rest of the shift is 8 h 45 min - 1 h 30 min = 7 h 15 min after midnight. So it ends at 07:15.
items.hint: How long is it from 22:30 to midnight?

items.text: 2 m 40 cm = {b} cm
A bottle holds 1 ℓ 200 ml. A child drinks 700 ml. The bottle then holds {b} ml.
A bus trip starts at 9:40 am and ends at 11:10 am. It lasts {b} h {b} min.
items.explanation: 9:40 to 10:00 is 20 min. 10:00 to 11:00 is 1 h. 11:00 to 11:10 is 10 min. In all: 1 h 30 min.

items.text: Kumar buys a snack for $2.35. He pays with a $5 note. His change is ${bw}.
